cases.refreshed: Participating in the Reading to Children program is a great way for children to develop their imagination and spark a love for books, reading, and learning. Children will enjoy one-on-one or small group interactions with our reading volunteer. Kids are also welcome to practice reading aloud with our volunteer. Please note, this is not a tutoring session. Reading to Children will take place in the Children's Area.
